objective: Implement the meeting recording flow so starting a recording immediately creates a linked local audio path, raw capture, and draft meeting record, with pause/resume/stop and restoration from persisted local state.
success_criteria: Starting a recording creates a draft meeting record and linked raw capture before later processing.
The flow exposes pause, resume, and stop operations at the application layer.
A local audio path is reserved under local storage so interrupted recordings remain recoverable.
The flow can restore a recording session from persisted meeting and raw capture state without relying on network services.
stop_conditions: The task requires platform audio APIs or UI shell work.
The task requires schema changes outside the current meeting and raw capture models.
The task requires remote services instead of local application state.
approval_gates: Changing persistence schema instead of implementing on the current foundation
notes: This slice is application-flow only and should leave platform recorder integration for later work.
